name: What are the benefits of upgrading to impact-resistant windows and doors?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of upgrading to impact-resistant windows and doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upgrading to impact-resistant windows and doors offers enhanced protection against high winds and flying debris, a valuable feature for homes, especially in areas prone to strong weather. Beyond storm protection, they also provide increased security against intruders due to their robust construction. Additionally, these units often come with improved noise reduction and energy efficiency, contributing to a quieter and more comfortable indoor environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Impact-resistant windows and doors offer enhanced protection from storms, increased security, and improved noise reduction and energy efficiency.
